items.name: Hand Hygiene: The Five Moments Explained
items.description: Short animated video explaining when and why to clean hands during patient care.

items.name: Basic Life Support (BLS) Refresher
items.description: Hands-on refresher covering adult and paediatric basic life support, including CPR and use of an AED.

items.name: Safeguarding Adults Level 2
items.description: Builds confidence in recognising signs of abuse and neglect in adults and knowing how to escalate concerns.

items.name: Reducing Missed Medication Doses on Ward Rounds
items.description: Team-based project using data and ward-round observations to reduce missed or delayed medication doses.

items.name: Infection Prevention and Control Essentials
items.description: Covers standard precautions, hand hygiene, PPE and cleaning practices to reduce healthcare-associated infections.

items.name: Manual Handling Practical Skills
items.description: Practical session on safe moving and handling techniques for patients and equipment to prevent injury.

items.name: PDSA Cycle Workshop: Improving Discharge Planning
items.description: Workshop applying Plan-Do-Study-Act cycles to test changes that make patient discharge smoother and safer.

items.name: Recognising the Deteriorating Patient
items.description: Case-based video showing how to spot early signs of patient deterioration and respond effectively.

items.name: Your Role in Keeping Patient Data Safe
items.description: Brief explainer on everyday practices that protect patient confidentiality and prevent data breaches.

items.name: Information Governance and Data Security Awareness
items.description: Explains staff responsibilities for handling patient information securely and in line with data protection law.

items.name: Conflict Resolution and De-escalation
items.description: Teaches practical techniques for recognising early warning signs and de-escalating challenging situations.

items.name: Reducing Inpatient Falls: A Ward-Based QI Project
items.description: Ward-based project testing practical measures, such as risk assessments and bedside checks, to reduce inpatient falls.

items.name: Oliver McGowan Mandatory Training on Learning Disability and Autism
items.description: Interactive training to improve understanding of learning disability and autism and deliver better, more inclusive care.

items.name: Speaking Up: How to Raise a Concern
items.description: Staff stories and practical tips on raising concerns safely and what happens after you speak up.

items.name: Sepsis Recognition and Management
items.description: Teaches early identification of sepsis, use of screening tools and prompt escalation and treatment pathways.

items.name: Medicines Management and Safe Administration
items.description: Covers safe prescribing, storage, administration and recording of medicines, including error prevention.

items.name: Streamlining Outpatient Appointment Reminders
items.description: Project trialling clearer, more timely appointment reminders to reduce missed outpatient appointments.

items.name: Fire Safety Awareness
items.description: Overview of fire prevention, evacuation procedures and the correct use of fire safety equipment.

items.name: Supporting Colleagues Through Burnout
items.description: Expert-led video on spotting signs of burnout and ways to support yourself and your colleagues.

items.name: Reducing Pressure Ulcers Through Early Risk Assessment
items.description: Project focused on earlier risk assessment and repositioning routines to prevent pressure ulcers.

items.name: Leadership Essentials for New Team Leaders
items.description: Introduces core leadership skills for new team leaders, including communication, delegation and supporting teams.

items.name: Quality Improvement Fundamentals
items.description: Introduces the principles and tools of quality improvement, including how to plan and run a small project.

items.name: Introduction to Trauma-Informed Care
items.description: Overview of trauma-informed care principles and how they shape compassionate patient interactions.

items.name: Cutting Theatre Turnaround Times: QI Showcase
items.description: Showcase of a multidisciplinary project to reduce theatre turnaround times and improve list efficiency.
